title: 2-Pair MisGAN: 100-Mode 8D Block Sensor Dropout
intuition: Trains a 2-pair incomplete-data MisGAN (detached mask gradient in L_x) on an 8D sensor-block dropout embedding of 100 modes, requiring complete 100/100 mode recovery, low off-plane error (<= 0.04), accurate mask TV, and posterior imputation accuracy.
failure_mode: Without detached mask gradients or strong 100-mode support representation, the data generator hallucinates off-subspace artifacts in unobserved sensor blocks.
